cards.unit_title: Section 1: Can you sell a packed house?
cards.title: Three questions to settle first
cards.purpose: Lets the reader see the three first questions at a glance before they read on.
cards.placement: After the numbered list in section 1, before the next heading.
cards.generation_prompt: A plain checklist graphic with three empty rows, flat simple shapes in calm navy with orange accents on a light background, wide 16:9 composition with clear empty space on the right of each row where the text will go. Calm, reassuring mood. No text, no letters, no people.
avoid: any text or letters in the image
cards.alt_text: A checklist of three first questions: authority to sign, what is owed, what the house needs.

cards.unit_title: Section 2: What does state law list?
cards.title: The law's list and the condition it sets
cards.purpose: Shows the law's list of conditions next to the one threshold that decides whether they count, so the reader does not stop at the list.
cards.placement: Right after the paragraph that opens section 2.

versions.change: The text is now the whole locked sentence (it had dropped the condition).

cards.generation_prompt: A calm two-part layout: on the left a simple stack of three plain horizontal bars, on the right one larger rounded panel, flat shapes in navy with orange accents on a light background, wide 16:9 composition with clear empty space inside the bars and the panel where the text will go. Reassuring, careful mood. No text, no letters, no people.
avoid: any text or letters in the image

text_overlay.text: California's Health and Safety Code lists conditions that can make a building substandard, such as junk and debris that are fire, health or safety hazards.
The law counts them only when they endanger life, limb, health, property, safety or welfare.

cards.alt_text: A list of conditions on the left and, on the right, the condition that must be met for them to count.

notes.text: Is the two-part layout OK for a long sentence on the right? It might get small.
The text changed to the whole sentence, so v2 of the card is the one to make. Give the right panel more room.

cards.title: Your options at a glance
cards.purpose: Shows the three routes side by side so the reader sees they have a choice, not a single path.
cards.placement: After the bulleted list in section 3.
cards.generation_prompt: A simple flow diagram with one starting shape on the left that branches into three equal rounded boxes on the right, flat shapes in navy with orange arrows on a light background, wide 16:9 composition with clear empty space inside every box and the start shape where the text will go. Calm, balanced mood. No text, no letters, no people.
avoid: any text or letters in the image
cards.alt_text: One starting point leading to three options: keep the house, clear it first, sell it as it is.

cards.unit_title: Section 4: What to do this week
cards.title: Paperwork to gather
cards.purpose: Gives the reader a simple visual for the short list of things to gather this week.
cards.generation_prompt: A row of three simple flat icons on a light background: a folder, a clipboard and a handshake outline, drawn in navy with a single orange accent each, wide 16:9 composition with clear empty space under each icon where the text will go. Tidy, encouraging mood. No text, no letters, no people.
avoid: any text or letters in the image

text_overlay.text: List the people who can sign.

cards.alt_text: Three simple icons for the three things to do this week.
